convertibility_reason: Uses Martingale position sizing via external .mqh library with global variable persistence, margin-dependent lot doubling on losses, and tick-volume intrabar filter requiring tick-level execution fidelity

derived_values.name: MACD1 histogram direction: t[0]>t[1] (falling), t[0]>t[1]&&t[1]<t[2] (valley crossover)
Last closed order profit direction: cl-op for BUY, op-cl for SELL

other_exits: SL/TP only - no signal-based close; opposite signal closes current position via PositionSelect check then opens new direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: DML=1000 sets the Shape (deposit fraction base lot); Ud=1 sets DoublingCount; on loss the lot is doubled up to DoublingCount times, then reset; state persisted via global variables across restarts

custom_logic_notes: Dual-MACD valley/peak crossover system: Long when MACD1 main line makes a valley (t[0]>t[1] && t[1]<t[2]) AND MACD2 is rising (k[1]>k[0]); Short when MACD1 makes a peak (t[0]<t[1] && t[1]>t[2]) AND MACD2 is falling (k[1]<k[0]). Uses bars [1],[2],[3] (CopyBuffer shift=1, count=3 → t[0]=bar1, t[1]=bar2, t[2]=bar3). After a losing trade, the EA forces the opposite direction (poz=-1 after buy loss, poz=1 after sell loss) applying martingale lot doubling. After a win, normal MACD signal logic resumes. tick_volume>1 guard skips non-first ticks of a bar. OnTester custom metric: profit_count/loss_count divided by (max_series_loss+1), rejects if Tp<Stop.
python_conversion_notes: Martingale class from Martingail.mqh must be reimplemented: it manages lot sizing with Shape (deposit fraction), DoublingCount (max consecutive doublings), and global variable persistence. The EA forces opposite-direction trades after losses (not pure signal-based), which is critical for backtest accuracy. tick_volume>1 filter requires at least M1 data with volume; tick data preferred. SL/TP use Point() directly without 5-digit adjustment - conversion must handle _Point normalization. The OnTester custom metric (profitc_divide_lossc / max_series_loss) from OnTesterFunctions.mqh is backtest-only and can be omitted for live trading conversion.
